summary: Frontend-only testing completed for pastel 3D 'bombé' styles across the application. All requested features verified: (1) NavigationSections with pastel pill-shaped cards, (2) Profile page with pastel collapsible sections, (3) FoodLibraryPage with pastel food cards, (4) Baby names page with pastel styling, (5) Postpartum page with pastel cards and badges. The 'Précautions' accordions could not be directly tested as the postpartum content requires purchase, but the PrecautionsSection.jsx code shows proper AccordionCard implementation with pastel styles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pastel 3D 'bombé' styles tested across multiple pages. The styles use linear-gradient backgrounds with inset box-shadows for the 3D effect. Key components: PastelComponents.jsx (utility), NavigationSections.jsx (home page cards), CollapsibleSection.jsx (profile), FoodLibraryPage.js (food library), ExpandableNameCard.jsx (baby names). The 'Astuces' tutorial popup appears after login and requires clicking 'Compris !' button (there are 2 buttons with this text - use .nth(1) for TutorialPopup). Admin account is blocked due to failed login attempts.
